agentCardUrl.description: New card URL, fetched on the next refresh-card with the headers and the connection's token. `remote-a2a-agent update` refuses one on another origin while the update keeps the agent's credentials.

headers.description: Newline-separated Name:Value lines, sent with the card fetch and every call. A value of exactly %ASSETS/<asset-name>% is replaced by that Orchestrator asset's value, from the agent's folder, each time the header is sent. An Authorization line is not sent while the agent has a connection. Omitted keeps the stored headers; an empty string removes them all. A header sent back with the masked value **** keeps its stored value; `remote-a2a-agent update` refuses **** under a name `remote-a2a-agent get` does not show masked.

agentCardJson.description: The agent card as a JSON string, stored as the card instead of fetching one. The service calls the endpoint the card names. Replaces the stored card; `remote-a2a-agent update` refuses one whose endpoint is on another origin while the update keeps the agent's credentials.

connectionId.description: Integration Service connection whose token authenticates the card fetch and every call, in place of an Authorization header. Use an OAuth connection of the Agent 2 Agent connector (uipath-google-agent2agent), the one Agent Gateway offers: the service stores any connection Integration Service finds, and one it gets no OAuth token from fails every call. Omitted or null keeps the stored one.

clearConnectionId.description: Removes the stored connection. Cannot be combined with connectionId.

useRelay.description: Route the card fetch and every call through UiPath Relay, for an agent in a private network. Omitted keeps the stored setting. Send it with an agentCardUrl on a Relay agent: the service checks the URL as a public host unless this payload sets it to true.
